conflict_resolutions.EMPTY_CATALOG_NOTE_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH_CU: The catalog note for this order is empty. An empty note is not evidence of continuing effect, of ending, or of anything else; I treated it as no observation and based my view on the held original and other held text only.

material_gaps: No held ending instrument superseding the 1928 Manual amendments.
notice: Producer research decision only. Independent review and owner adoption remain separate.
rationale: I read the complete held EO 9324 (8 FR 4225, Mar 31, 1943, Amending the Manual for Courts-Martial, United States Army (1928)): several amendments to paragraphs of the 1928 Manual. No own-term. The 1928 Manual was later replaced (Manual for Courts-Martial 1949, 1951 after the Uniform Code of Military Justice), which would likely end the amendments, but no held ACT:, TERM: or ACTOR_TEXT: record names or replaces it. Catalog note is empty and the flag EMPTY_CATALOG_NOTE_DOES_NOT_ESTABLISH_CURRENT_EFFECT applies: an empty note is not evidence of continuing effect. Blocked pending the superseding Manual instrument and its savings terms.
